annotation.title_clean: 物資の流通の効率化に関する法律施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the Act on Improvement of Efficiency of Distribution of Goods (Logistics Efficiency Act Enforcement Rules)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 農林水産省・経済産業省・国土交通省 (MAFF, METI, MLIT Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance implementing the Logistics Efficiency Act. It sets facility standards and application procedures for certifying integrated logistics efficiency plans. Standards for warehouses list automated guided vehicles, automated storage and industrial robots for cargo handling as qualifying equipment. It has no AI governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets required content for logistics facility plans and certification applications.
Defines facility standards by category, including location near highways, ports and rail freight stations.
Lists automated guided vehicles, automated storage and industrial robots among qualifying warehouse equipment.
Assigns application routing to regional bureaus and prefectural governors.
Sets a five-year validity period for facility confirmation.
